title: Unravel Me
author: Tahereh Mafi
summary: Juliette, whose touch can kill, has escaped the regime that held her and joined a rebel group led by Adam's friends. She struggles with her growing power, her feelings for Adam and a threat from Warner.
readIf: you enjoyed the first Shatter Me book and like ornate, emotional prose in a YA dystopian romance.
skipIf: you find heavily stylised, metaphor-rich writing and strikethrough text tiresome.
